items.title: GoodLeap remains an operating home-improvement and solar-finance company
items.notes: GoodLeap's current site identifies GoodLeap, LLC as formerly Loanpal and continues to market financing/home-energy products.

items.title: GoodLeap lists residential solar availability in 27 states plus Washington, D.C.
items.notes: GoodLeap states not all products are available in all states or for all utilities. This list is narrower than its 46-state plus D.C. corporate licensing footprint.

items.title: BBB displays more than 1,200 GoodLeap complaints over the prior three years
items.notes: BBB complaints are consumer allegations and are not independently verified facts. Counts are a point-in-time snapshot and should be refreshed before publication.

items.title: CFPB publishes solar-financing issue spotlight citing Minnesota v. GoodLeap
items.notes: The report focuses on dealer fees/markups, tax-credit representations, payment increases and savings representations in solar-specific lending.

items.title: Freedom Forever bankruptcy filing describes GoodLeap as a critical financing partner
items.notes: The bankruptcy motion describes a GoodLeap Program Agreement and seeks approval of a settlement between Freedom Forever and GoodLeap. This creates a major research lane for identifying affected GoodLeap-financed Freedom Forever customers by state.

items.title: GoodLeap announces solar lease/PPA and broader securitization transactions
items.notes: Company-reported financing activity is relevant to establishing that GoodLeap remains active and has shifted/expanded into leases and PPAs. Treat as a company statement, not independent reporting.
